title: Four requirements, four constructs
prompt: Place each requirement with the construct that should carry it.

pairs.item: Bring Glean context into the IDE for engineers.
pairs.why: The engineering copilot scenario uses the Glean MCP server to bring Glean context into Cursor or VS Code.

pairs.item: Create an onboarding request in an internal system and return an ID and link.
pairs.why: That is the documented example custom action: an internal IT onboarding action returning a request ID plus link.

pairs.item: Enforce one methodology for account plans across every consultant.
pairs.why: Standardized consulting delivery uses a skill to enforce the same methodology.

pairs.item: Run every morning, check new content, and route exceptions for approval.
pairs.why: Scheduled, event-driven, or governed end-to-end workflows are agent work.

takeaway: Same four categories, harder inputs. If you can sort these, you can run the conversation live.
